title: Price and entitlement draft

sku.description: immutable unique product plan key. No arbitrary client prices

currency.description: supported merchant approved currency. Currency exponent from currency metadata

amount_minor.description: >=0 within approved test/live pricing. Not float cents

interval.description: approved plan interval. No hidden renewal

portfolio_limit.description: nonnegative;defined unlimited only as explicit policy. No unexplained null unlimited

features.description: reviewed entitlement registry. No implicit trading right

mode.description: live requires merchant/owner price approval. No auto paid launch

description: Ready-input schema plus server business validation. Draft input uses identical property types but permits missing required fields; missingness must be displayed. Identity/password forms never saved as drafts.
